title: BMG Buys NJ School Site
body: Jackson, NJ Township Board of Education approves $40 million sale of Christa McAuliffe Middle School to Beth Medrash Govoha, with no details on future use.

title: Jonathan Pollard's Flag Request
body: Jonathan Pollard urged PM Netanyahu & Defense Minister Yisroel Katz to raise the Israeli flag at the former Nisanit community in northern Gaza ahead of Chanukah.
